# MediVault

Decentralized health vault that keeps records owner-controlled and easy to understand.

## Problem it solves

Health reports are hard to read and hard to own. MediVault secures them and summarizes them in plain language.

## How it works

1. Records are encrypted and pinned to IPFS with on-chain pointers.
2. Owner grants or revokes access per record.
3. AI assistance summarizes long reports and organizes history.

## Tech stack

- Solidity + IPFS for ownership and storage
- React for vault UI
- OpenAI-assisted summarization

## Key features

- Patient-owned sharing model
- Verifiable storage pointers
- Readable AI summaries
